Assistant Watchers are always-on agents that check a scoped part of your telemetry on a schedule. You describe what to monitor, Assistant calibrates concrete checks against your data, and the watcher raises concern when a run finds something notable.

Watchers are available only in Grafana Cloud. Use them for recurring service health checks, noisy-but-important failure modes, and follow-up monitoring after an incident.

## Here's what to expect

When you complete this path, you'll be able to:

- Open Watchers and create a narrow watcher with context, data sources, cadence, and sensitivity
- Calibrate checks and review the calibration baseline
- Trigger **Run now** and pause the automatic runs with the **Active** switch
- Check the watcher's verdict and review the evidence behind **All clear**, **Flagged**, or **Escalated** in a run report

## Before you begin

- A Grafana Cloud account. [Create an account](https://grafana.com/signup/cloud/connect-account) if you need one.
- Grafana Assistant enabled on your stack, with any required Assistant terms accepted. If it isn't enabled yet, follow [Set up Grafana Assistant in Grafana Cloud](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/platform/grafana-assistant/get-started/grafana-cloud/). On some stacks, an administrator must enable it.
- A Prometheus, Loki, or BigQuery data source that's receiving data from a service now. Assistant builds the watcher's checks from that data.
- Permission to view, create, and run watchers. The **Assistant User** role includes Watchers. For the exact permissions, refer to [Manage Assistant access with RBAC](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/platform/grafana-assistant/privacy-and-security/rbac/).

Assistant is billed based on usage, and each watcher run uses tokens from your plan's allowance. Refer to [Understand Grafana Assistant pricing and usage](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/platform/grafana-assistant/pricing/).

For full setup details, refer to [Use Assistant Watchers](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/platform/grafana-assistant/platform/watchers/).

## Troubleshooting

If you get stuck, we've got your back! Where appropriate, troubleshooting information is just a click away.

## More to explore

We understand you might want to explore other capabilities not strictly on this path. We'll provide you opportunities where it makes sense.
